The first address is the address of an I2C slave, and the second one is I2C~slave~'s memory address (i.e., addrM in Figure 27.5-3).
When using double addressing, RAM must be accessed in non-FIFO mode.
The I2C~slave~ put received byte0 ~ byte(N-1) into its RAM in an order staring from addrM.
